directive.gatingQuestion: Does Eaton's lower year-over-year Q2 2026 segment margin contradict the routed evidence of strong sales/order growth and operating leverage potential?
directive.whyItMatters: The live ranked queue still assigns unresolved_material_contradiction to deep-resolver even though prior resolver evidence closed the factual conflict; repeated unchanged routing must not cause an infinite research loop.
directive.successCondition: Identify materially new conflicting evidence or preserve the prior resolved disposition and stop repeated exception research.

finding: Primary-source recheck remains unchanged: Q2 sales rose 21%, organic sales 14%, electrical orders/backlog accelerated, total segment margin was 23.1% (down 80 bps year over year but above guidance), and Electrical Americas margin improved 190 bps sequentially. The observations are compatible with acquisition/mix pressure and do not form a factual contradiction. Prior resolver evidence already resolved this exact route; no new contradictory evidence is available, so further resolver looping is unavailable as a productive closure path.

evidenceVsInference.evidence: Issuer-reported Q2 2026 sales were $8.5B (+21%), organic growth 14%, segment margin 23.1% (down 80 bps YoY, above guidance), Electrical Americas margin 27.5% (+190 bps sequentially), with strong electrical orders/backlog.
evidenceVsInference.inference: Strong demand and sequential margin expansion can coexist with year-over-year acquisition/mix dilution; the latter remains underwriting risk rather than a contradiction gate.

recommendedDisposition: Do not route ETN back to deep-resolver for this unchanged contradiction. Reconcile the existing resolved disposition; retain acquisition/mix margin-conversion risk outside the contradiction gate.
